title: LendInvest provides £3.51m for Bromley NHS site conversion
summary:
LendInvest has completed a £3.51 million development finance facility for the conversion of a former NHS building in Bromley into 16 residential flats, closing the transaction in 6.5 weeks to meet contractual deadlines. The facility was structured at 65% loan-to-gross-development-value over an 18-month term.

title: Investec provides £19.25m for Birmingham student scheme
summary:
Investec Bank has provided a £19.25 million senior development loan to Barwood for a 233-bed purpose-built student accommodation scheme in Edgbaston, Birmingham. The 36-month facility will finance development and stabilisation of the project on the former St Chad's Hospital site, which dates to 1808.

title: Government rejects new HMO conversion restrictions
summary:
The Government has rejected calls for new legislation to restrict family homes from being converted into houses in multiple occupation. Housing Minister Matthew Pennycook stated that local authorities already possess adequate planning powers through Article 4 Directions to control HMO growth.

The post Government rejects new HMO conversion restrictions appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Property prices near top-rated nurseries carry £78,000 premium
summary:
Properties located near nurseries rated highly by Ofsted are selling at a significant premium, with homebuyers paying an average of £77,926 more to secure proximity to top-rated childcare facilities. Analysis shows homes within catchment areas of 'outstanding' nurseries are worth 16% more on average than properties in the wider local authority area.

title: Borrowers shift to two-year mortgages despite rate premium
summary:
Property buyers are increasingly choosing two-year fixed-rate mortgages despite higher rates, with demand rising from 48.4% to 55.6% between February and May. Industry body Propertymark has warned against making decisions based solely on rate forecasts.

title: NAO reveals royal property sub-letting arrangements
summary:
A National Audit Office report has disclosed that Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor received rental income from sub-letting three cottages on the Royal Lodge estate. The report also revealed that the King pays rent for accommodation occupied by Mountbatten-Windsor's daughters from his personal funds.

title: Northern Labour MPs call for land value tax to replace council tax
summary:
A group of northern Labour MPs is calling on Andy Burnham to replace Council Tax with a Land Value Tax, arguing the current system creates unfair burdens on lower-value properties in the North. The MPs claim Council Tax, based on 1991 property valuations, disproportionately affects northern residents compared to those in high-value southern areas.

title: Agent ordered to pay £575 after non-disclosure ruling
summary:
A property agent has been ordered to reimburse a buyer £575 in survey costs after failing to disclose that a property was of non-standard construction. The Property Ombudsman ruled that construction type constitutes material information that should have been made available to prospective buyers.

title: Social housing waiting lists would take 119 years to clear
summary:
England's social housing waiting lists would take 119 years to clear at current construction rates, according to research by Shelter. More than 1.3 million households are waiting for social homes, whilst only 12,198 were built last year.

title: UK house prices decline for third consecutive month
summary:
UK house prices fell 0.1% in May to £298,806, marking the third consecutive monthly decline according to Halifax data. The drop defied analyst expectations as elevated mortgage rates continue to impact affordability and buyer demand.
